name: HazopActionCloseoutTracker
tagline: Every HAZOP, LOPA and PHA recommendation – ranked, owned, evidenced and independently verified.
description: A complete process-safety app in one Power Apps component: HAZOP / LOPA study worksheets by node, 5×5 initial and residual risk ranking, owners and due dates set from the risk band, deferrals with an extension limit, close-out evidence linked to the MOC, independent verification, a close-out board, a risk matrix and a status report for the PSM committee. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: 5×5 risk matrix (initial and residual) with configurable thresholds
Due dates by risk band, due-soon and overdue tracking
Deferral with reason, extension counter and limit
Close-out evidence, completion date, residual risk and MOC reference for high risk
LOPA gap tracking until the IPL is in place
HAZOP worksheet per study grouped by node
Bulk start work, default due dates, assign, delete with undo
CSV export, activity log, back / forward, keyboard and touch
Phone layout with bottom view bar
